review_notes: I read all 126 lines of the file. A grep for def, structure, class, instance, abbrev and noncomputable def at the start of a line found no matches. The rubric asks whether the file introduces a competing version of a Mathlib concept, and it explicitly excludes standalone theorem duplication. Since this file introduces no definitions, structures, classes or instances, the rubric has nothing here to apply to. Any overlap between the imported OAI definitions and Mathlib belongs in a review of the files where those definitions are made.
